name: T5 Chicago II

profile.reading: This facility is attributed to T5 Data Centers, whose own site states the company has been operating for nearly two decades, implying a founding around the mid-2000s, through two divisions: T5 Properties, a development and ownership platform, and T5 Services, a construction and operations division licensed as a general contractor in 48 states. The company reports more than 3 gigawatts under management, 4 million square feet of developed data center space, and 22 data centers developed. The fetched page referenced Chicago and the broader Chicagoland area in a construction case study context, consistent with this registry Illinois facility, but did not specifically name Cleveland, Ohio, or Elk Grove Village by name. No headquarters address, ownership structure, or building specific address and MW figures for this particular registry row were located in available sourcing this session.
profile.research_note: General company scale and a Chicagoland reference confirmed; Cleveland/Ohio market not individually confirmed this session. Revisit with fresh WebSearch budget.
